tasks.short: Supervise criminal investigations and guide lawful procedures

steps.what: Retrieve case records, outstanding actions and applicable procedure versions for investigation review
Assess investigation progress, evidence gaps and compliance with laws and regulations
Guide investigators and coordinate lawful next actions and escalation

tasks.design: Configure a case review view in the {OTHER} police case system, linking source records and current procedures in {DOCS}. The supervisor checks completeness and retains legal assessment and investigative guidance; no inferred guilt or automated operational instruction is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supervisors retrieve case information across records before discussing progress.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case views and document links can reduce repeated retrieval.
tasks.still_hard: Assessing evidence gaps and the legality and proportionality of next actions.
tasks.human_edge: Accountable guidance informed by uncertainty and investigators' context.
tasks.altitude: Less retrieval before review; investigative authority remains unchanged.

evidence.claim: Native source-linked case views can reduce retrieval effort; this design and saving are E1 assumptions.
The digest reports no net workload drop in the Dutch short-report and camera-footage pilot, so it does not justify narrative drafting savings here.

assumptions: Boundary is supervisor preparation, review and guidance, excluding investigators' original evidence gathering and recording.

Existing investigators produce case identifier, record timestamp, action owner, due date and source document during their unchanged case-recording workflow. No extra fields are demanded; supervisor checks missing entries manually within s1's ten retained hours.
Test native views first; no new case classification or risk score is required. If new investigator capture is needed, cost it separately before rollout.
Two incremental supervisor hours per 100 baseline hours cover view and source-link checks.
unknowns: Existing case fields, permissions and retrieval time
research_questions: Does a native review view save retrieval time after completeness checks?

already_counted.description: Case-pack completeness checks and manual retrieval exceptions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R90; gross10 less2 upkeep gives8 net. Sparse records may save only2 retrieval hours, giving zero net; judgement and guidance remain80.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare duty schedules and assign staff

steps.what: Capture staffing requirements, availability, qualifications, rest constraints and assignment restrictions
Prepare a feasible work schedule from checked staffing constraints
Resolve staffing conflicts and approve the exact duty schedule and assignments
Publish approved work schedules and duty assignments to staff

tasks.design: Configure a constraint scheduler in {HCM}, testing its native staffing rules before custom work. The supervisor captures requirements and resolves exceptions, then approves an exact roster for publication through the staff portal and {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual roster construction repeats availability and working-time comparisons.
tasks.enabler_now: Constraint scheduling can generate feasible options and identify conflicts without a model.
tasks.still_hard: Operational priorities, fairness and unexpected staffing shortages.
tasks.human_edge: Resolving trade-offs with staff and accepting responsibility for coverage.

ambition.what: Compare feasible coverage options after a material absence before issuing a revised roster

tasks.altitude: Less roster construction; more time for operational coverage choices without changing assignment authority.

reach.task: Validate staffing constraints and roster fairness

evidence.claim: ORTEC Workforce generates schedules using labour-law and collective-agreement constraints while planners retain control.
Dutch working and rest-time arrangements involve works council consent; public-task decisions have specific participation boundaries.
The task shares and net saving are E1 scenarios, not measured police scheduling results.

assumptions: Boundary includes supervisor constraint capture, roster construction, conflict resolution and publication; staff availability reporting remains its existing workflow.

Supervisor produces staff identifiers, dates, availability intervals, qualification validity, minimum coverage, rest rules and assignment restrictions in fully retained s1. Missing records require manual confirmation there; infeasible cases return to fully retained s3.

S3 produces approved roster version, staff recipients and assignment rows consumed by s4. Approval binds the complete version; edits require renewed review. Delivery exceptions are covered by incremental upkeep.
Native scheduler configuration is tested first. Four incremental supervisor hours per 100 baseline hours cover rule updates and publication exceptions.
unknowns: Local agreements, scheduler availability and staffing constraints
research_questions: How much construction time remains after constraint capture, conflict resolution and delivery failures?

already_counted.description: Constraint capture and roster conflict resolution with exact approval

incremental.description: Constraint updates, delivery exceptions and access checks

approvals.approved_version: Exact roster version, assignments, dates and recipients approved in s3; any edit voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R50; gross50 less4 upkeep gives46 net. Heavy shortages may leave only19 hours saved in construction and distribution, giving15 net; input capture and conflict resolution retain50.

tasks.short: Direct evidence and prisoner-property collection and handling

steps.what: Direct collection, preparation and handling of evidence and prisoners' personal property
Record supervisory custody checks and confirm discrepancies in the evidence register

tasks.design: Configure the {OTHER} evidence register to reuse verified custody details for supervisory checks. The supervisor records observations and discrepancies directly, while collection and handling directions remain fully human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supervisory checks can duplicate custody identifiers and receipt details.
tasks.enabler_now: Native register forms can prefill existing custody data and preserve audit history.
tasks.still_hard: Actual item identity, contamination risks and broken custody chains.
tasks.human_edge: Verifying physical reality and stopping unsafe or unlawful handling.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less duplicate recording; no reduction in physical oversight.

evidence.claim: Reusing existing register fields for supervisory checks is an E1 design assumption; the digest offers no evidence-handling savings case.

assumptions: Boundary includes supervision and its custody-check record, excluding officers' physical handling and original item registration.

Existing collecting officers produce item identifier, case identifier, receipt time and custody holder during unchanged registration. Supervisor produces observed condition, check time and discrepancy description in s2; all first capture and manual missing-field work remain in its nine hours.
Test native register forms first; no inferred discrepancy code or autonomous release of property is introduced.
Two additional supervisor hours per 100 baseline hours cover form and audit checks.
unknowns: Current evidence register fields and actual duplicate-recording effort
research_questions: Can prefilled custody fields save time without weakening physical verification?

already_counted.description: First capture, discrepancy checks and supervisory record review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R94; gross6 minus2 upkeep gives4 net. If duplicate entry is absent, gross0 yields minus2; physical supervision retains85.

tasks.short: Investigate personnel problems and staff misconduct allegations

steps.what: Interview involved staff and gather accounts and records concerning personnel problems or misconduct
Prepare the restricted source bundle and index for personnel-case review
Assess conflicting accounts and decide or recommend a proportionate resolution within authority
Explain the resolution to involved staff and arrange any authorised follow-up

tasks.design: Use restricted folders and bundle export in {DOCS} to assemble sources without drafting findings. Interviews, credibility assessment and resolution remain with the supervisor under existing personnel procedures.
tasks.previous_blocker: Preparing review bundles repeats document ordering and indexing.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document metadata and export can assemble an auditable source bundle.
tasks.still_hard: Fair fact-finding, disputed accounts and proportionate resolution.
tasks.human_edge: Listening impartially and explaining difficult outcomes.
tasks.altitude: Less bundle assembly; no change to disciplinary authority.

evidence.claim: Native document indexing and bundle export support source preparation; the saving is an E1 task scenario.

assumptions: Boundary covers supervisor investigation and resolution within existing authority; formal sanctions requiring another authority remain outside and are not accelerated.

Supervisor produces checked notes and source identifiers in fully retained s1. S2's nine retained hours include case identifier, document date, source, access-group capture and bundle completeness checks; missing metadata is entered manually there.
Native document functions are tested first. No credibility score, emotion analysis or automated misconduct finding is introduced.
Two incremental supervisor hours per 100 baseline hours cover restricted-folder and template checks.
unknowns: Personnel authority, required consultation and source-bundle preparation time
research_questions: Does indexed export reduce bundle preparation after permission and completeness checks?

already_counted.description: Metadata capture, access and bundle completeness review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R94; gross6 less2 upkeep gives4 net. Small or poorly indexed cases may save nothing and lose2 to upkeep; interviews and resolution retain85.
